definitions.explanation: A commercial exchange of goods, services, or money.
An ongoing business relationship between parties.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{取引|とりひき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}しなかった→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: This deal did not go through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株式|かぶしき}→株式：04772_kabushiki⟧{取引|とりひき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{取引|とりひき} is a compound: ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (taking) + ⟦{引|ひ}き→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (pulling) = exchange.

TYPES OF TRANSACTIONS:
- ⟦{株式|かぶしき}→株式：04772_kabushiki⟧{取引|とりひき} (stock trading)
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧{取引|とりひき} (cash transaction)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{取引|とりひき} (electronic transaction)
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧{取引|とりひき} (fraudulent transaction)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取引|とりひき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do business, to trade)
- {取引|とりひき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have business relations)
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧ (business partner/client)
- {取引|とりひき}⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (terms of transaction)
